{{Top|leg}}
{{Otheruses|Bolt}}
A '''fusion bolt''' was a type of mechanical fastener used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Fusion bolts were used to attach [[Hull/Legends|hull]] plating to [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> They could be tightened or loosened by tools such as a [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanner]].<ref name="EGWT" />
